gate_source: .github/workflows/ci.yml (--cov-fail-under), mirrored here, in .github/auto-qa-tuning.json and in every doc that quotes it; tests/test_coverage_thresholds.py fails if any copy disagrees
note: measured_percent is a reading of HEAD and goes stale whenever a test lands — it sat at 61 while four test PRs took it to 82 (#63). Re-run `regenerate` and update measured_percent/measured_at when you touch this file. The threshold is deliberately set below the measured figure with headroom, not at the ceiling: it is a floor against regression, not a target to climb.
